name: move-to-dialog
title: Move to dialog
description: Pick the destination folder for one or many items: a searchable tree, the current location marked, new folder inline and the path spelled out.
docs: Give folders as nested nodes ({ id, name, children, disabled, reason }), the currentFolderId, itemCount and mode ("move" or "copy"); onMove(folderId) may return a promise, and the dialog locks while it runs and closes when it resolves. The folder the items are in is marked Already here and cannot be chosen while moving; while copying it is marked Current folder and can be, because a copy may go beside its original. movingIds names the folders that are themselves being moved: they and everything inside them cannot be chosen, and each says why. A node with disabled and a reason cannot be chosen either. The search expands the matching branches; Enter in it chooses the first match. onCreateFolder(parentId, name) adds New folder, which puts a field under the selection; resolve with the new id or folder so it is chosen. The tree has a file manager's keyboard, and the chosen folder (or the one the items are in) is brought into view when it opens. On a narrow panel a folder that cannot be chosen gives its reason on a second line, whole. The foot spells the path out and the button names the folder. MoveToPanel is the inside on its own.
